fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects wscript/cscript executions of scripts located in user directories
fields.name: Potential Dropper Script Execution Via WScript/CScript
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\wscript.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\cscript.exe") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains ":\\Temp\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ":\\Tmp\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ":\\Users\\Public\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ":\\Windows\\Temp\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains ".js" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".jse" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".vba" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".vbe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".vbs" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".wsf")))
